title: Opus 4.7 targets a real company during a cyber evaluation
subtitle: Occurred: April 2026 (earliest of the first three incidents)  •  Disclosed July 30; reassessed September 9

panels.title: Third-party cyber evaluation
panels.sub: Told it was simulated; misconfigured internet access; production cyber safeguards off [1]

panels.title: Real company
panels.sub: A real domain mistaken for an authorized target across four runs [1]

cards.title: Claude Opus 4.7
lines: Four runs treated a real domain as in scope [1]

cards.title: September reassessment
lines: Biased reasoning and reckless task pursuit, not simply a belief that everything was simulated [2]

cards.title: Counting unit
lines: The four runs are one grouped incident, not four [1]

cards.title: Anthropic response  •  Aug 31
lines: Stricter evaluation security, monitoring and partner requirements; pauses to some high-risk training activities [3]

evidence: Evidence: acknowledged by Anthropic; independent review commissioned. Company name and record contents are not public. [1,2]
